text: Google's Gemini glasses are now open for pre order, and they start at three hundred ninety five US dollars. Here's what you get. Say Hey Gemini, or tap the frame, and ask about whatever you're looking at. They translate live speech in more than seventy languages. They read Google Maps directions into your ear. And they can add an event from a poster straight to your calendar. The battery lasts up to nine hours, and the case refills them up to seven times. Warby Parker frames start at three ninety five, Gentle Monster at four forty nine, and both go on sale December tenth. The catch. They only work with Google accounts from the US and South Korea. If you run a shop, decide now whether customers can record inside. Send this to the friend who keeps asking about smart glasses.
